❯ Fix the invoice rounding bug (totals off by a cent on multi-line invoices).

⏺ The fix depends on a rounding rule, and the two choices give different totals on 3% of invoices.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Rounding

How should invoice totals be rounded?

❯ 1. Round once at the end, half up
     Sum exact line amounts, then round the total. Matches the accountant's spreadsheet.
  2. Round each line, banker's rounding
     Keeps each printed line exact; totals can differ by a cent from the spreadsheet.
  3. Type something.
